tldr: Saturn in the 2nd house routes maturity and responsibility through livelihood and value.
body: With Saturn in the 2nd house, structure, limits, discipline, time, responsibility, fear, mastery, and earned authority move through money, resources, values, possessions, and self-worth. This makes how you earn, hold, spend, and define what is worth protecting a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to create something durable. Left unconscious, it can become fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, harsh self-judgment, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed.
gift: commitment, competence, patience, boundaries, and the ability to create something durable expressed through livelihood and value.
challenge: fear, rigidity, isolation, delay, harsh self-judgment, or treating pressure as proof that care is not allowed concentrated in livelihood and value.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
